notes.title: Version 2.02 Update!
notes.content:
Gabriel Knight has been updated for PC and Mac platforms! 

Version 2.02
* Fixed message writing on tomb so the voodoo code is readable again.
* Fixed a few cases where a character's head would spin uncontrollably until the next animation started.
* Fixed Gabriel's bedroom radio to be save/load friendly.
* Fixed a skip cutscene issue at Day 10.
* Fixed a retry position case in bayou.
* Gave Gabriel a few items to show Gerde.
* Minor sequence cleanup.
* Various minor bugfixes.

notes.title: Version 2.01 is live!
notes.content:
Another update has been pushed through today to fix the pink screen problem some Mac users were experiencing with 2.0. 

Changelog for Unity 5 update, v2.00/2.01

- updated to Unity 5
- various engine optimizations
- improved mime puzzle
- miscellaneous bug fixes
- fixed pink screen on cutscenes issue on Mac

Thanks!

notes.title: Bonus Soundtrack Update - A Special Unlock for Schattenjaegers, Just in Time for the Holidays
notes.content:
Hello, Shadow Hunters!

Thank you for celebrating Gabriel Knight's 20th anniversary with us!

For the past year, we have been re-introducing the world to what we know about Voodoo with [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/262000]Gabriel Knight: Sins of the Fathers 20th Anniversary Edition[/url] and now we think it's time to celebrate.

As a special holiday gift, we are unlocking access to the MP3 soundtrack for all current owners and future buyers of the game!

Your game will now be updated with the soundtrack files under your local files folder "OST".

Please investigate and enjoy!

From all of us at Pinkerton Road and Phoenix Online Studios, have a happy 2016!
